title: Project Phoenix - RS-S13: Diagnose Failure of Eval 255
abstract: Diagnosing the execution failure of Eval 255 from the main Study 013 run. My previous runner failed to capture stderr. This run executes only the seeded version of Eval 255's code and will report the full stdout and stderr to identify the root cause of the crash.

original_submission.content:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

sys.path.append('storage/telos/repro_kit')
from seeded_eval_runner import inject_seed

STUDY_DIR = "storage/telos/repro_studies/study_013_telos_I_legacy"
SOURCE_FILE = os.path.join(STUDY_DIR, "eval_255_source.py")
SEED = 42

def main():
    print("--- Diagnosing Failure of Eval 255 ---")
    
    with open(SOURCE_FILE, 'r') as f:
        code = f.read()
    
    seeded_code = inject_seed(code, SEED)
    temp_script_path = os.path.join(STUDY_DIR, "temp_seeded_255.py")
    with open(temp_script_path, 'w') as f:
        f.write(seeded_code)

    cmd = ["python", temp_script_path]
    result = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    
    print("\n--- STDOUT ---")
    print(result.stdout)
    print("\n--- STDERR ---")
    print(result.stderr)

    if os.path.exists(temp_script_path):
        os.remove(temp_script_path)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
